options.value: All Mail (every email across all folders, including Sent)

args.question: Which emails should I delete?
args.reason: "All my emails" is ambiguous — the Inbox only has received/unread mail, while All Mail contains everything including Sent. Deleting from All Mail is the most thorough option but also the most destructive.

content: I'll help you delete your emails. Since "all my emails" can mean different things (Inbox only vs. across all folders/labels), let me clarify scope first — but I'll proceed with the Inbox now since that's where you are, and we can expand if needed.
